description: Réseaux de collecte des Eaux Pluviales (EP issu de la Base de données RAEPA ) - Guyane (2020) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datacarto.geoguyane.fr. The database “Pluvial Water Collection Networks” (from the Potable Water Supply and Sanitation Networks – RAEPA) collects geolocated information from the Pluvial Water (EP) collection networks only on the municipalities of the Community of Aglomeration of the Coastal Centre of Guyana (CACL) and on Kourou. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Rainwater collection networks (EP from the RAEPA database) – Guyana (2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2020-04-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
